preconditions.description: The number of main courses and the total number of courses are within the specified bounds.
Each course dependency list contains valid course numbers.

preconditions.expression: The sum of all t_i does not exceed 10^5
preconditions.description: The total number of dependencies does not exceed the specified limit.

postconditions.description: The output is -1 if there is no way to get a specialty.
The output m is the minimum number of courses to pass to get a specialty.
The output course_order is the order of courses to pass in chronological order.

invariants.expression: all(course in course_order for course in main_courses)
invariants.description: All main courses are included in the course order.

invariants.expression: all(course in course_order for course in necessary_courses)
invariants.description: All necessary courses are included in the course order.
The length of the course order is equal to the minimum number of courses to pass.

invariants.expression: all(course_order[i] < course_order[i+1] for i in range(m-1))
invariants.description: The course order is in chronological order.
